messages:
DeployBot: Canary rollout started for release v2.5.3 -> 10% traffic. p95 latency exceeded threshold (210ms) for last 4m. Autopause suggested. telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/rollouts/3216549870
Jun: Reading signal. p95 spike localized to embeddings path. is it just eu-west1?
Maya: Confirmed — eu-west1 and us-west2 show 180-220ms. apac unaffected.
DeployBot: Autopause triggered; holding further traffic increases. To resume run `/deploy continue` or react :white_check_mark:.
Priya: Recommend manual rollback to v2.5.2 — pin and shift traffic back to stable. Faster and less risky than immediate rollforward.
Alex: +1. We saw similar regression tied to the kv-cache change in perf tests. pin is safer.
Maya: I'll draft customer comms and patch the release notes. ping when rollback starts.
Jun: Ops note — remember to clear prefix cache after rollback. command: `redwoodctl cache flush --prefix kv-2024-05`
Sam: Ops standing by to execute. ETA 3m.
Priya: If rollback exceeds 10m, alert CS and escalate to oncall director.
DeployBot: Deploy action queued: rollback -> v2.5.2. Operator: Sam. plan id: plan-9876. Run: `redwoodctl deploy rollback --service inference --to-tag v2.5.2 --plan plan-9876`
Sam: running rollback now.
Sam: started: 3216549905 — streaming progress.
Sam: stage 1: pinned v2.5.2 for canary hosts — done.
Sam: stage 2: traffic shift -> 50% to v2.5.2 — in progress.
Priya: Monitoring p95 and error rates.
Maya: Drafted customer note: "We've reverted a recent infrastructure change that caused elevated latency. Service has been restored to the previous stable version. We'll share a full update in 30 minutes."
Jun: Executing cache flush now: `redwoodctl cache flush --prefix kv-2024-05`
Sam: cache flush completed.
Sam: traffic now at 100% -> v2.5.2. Observed p95 down to ~95ms, error rate normal. rollback complete.
Priya: Thanks team. Opening postmortem ticket and scheduling rollback postmortem. CC @eng-ml for follow-up.
Maya: Sent customer comms to affected accounts. :email:
DeployBot: Deployment plan plan-9876 closed. Metrics stabilized: p95 within SLO.
Alex: :thumbsup: Good catch. Next steps: disable kv-cache patch in staging, run extended perf tests before reattempt.
Jun: Will add a guarded feature flag and do a slow canary next time.
